docs.title: Glossary
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • How dotted terms and the definition dialog work
  • Every studio, model, and operator term in one place
  • Links from each entry to the guide that teaches it

What this enables

  • Looking up Klein, Wan, LTX, Queue, latent, headroom, and the rest without leaving the page
  • Teaching vocabulary once so Create and Operate pages can stay task-focused

Dotted words open a definition

Across the docs, the first time a glossary term appears on a page it is underlined with dots.

  • Hover (or keyboard focus) to read the short definition
  • Click or press Enter / Space to open the dialog
  • Open full glossary entry jumps here
  • Esc or the backdrop closes the dialog

Terms inside code, headings, and links stay plain so copy-paste and navigation do not fight the modal.

flowchart LR
  Prose["Docs prose"] --> First["First match on the page"]
  First --> Hover["Hover: short definition"]
  First --> Click["Click: dialog"]
  Click --> Full["This page: long entry"]

Add or change a term in includes/glossary.json (unique id and aliases). Conventions: Project conventions.

docs.title: Klein 4B
docs.text:
FLUX.2 Klein 4B distilled FP8 is the default still engine in this studio. Distilled means quality is almost entirely the positive prompt: 4 steps, CFG 1.0, Qwen3-4B CLIP (flux2). Klein 9B is FLUX Non-Commercial and is not the lab default. See Klein, Wan, and LTX and Prompting.

Also called: FLUX.2 Klein 4B, FLUX.2 Klein, Klein

See also: T2I · Qwen3-4B · Wan 2.2 · LTX-2.5 · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: Wan 2.2
docs.text:
Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B is the silent motion lane. I2V prompts should be motion + one camera move — the start image owns look. Do not prompt audio or a score. Optional A14B and Fun InP packs are not part of download-models. See Klein, Wan, and LTX.

Also called: Wan 2.2 5B, TI2V-5B, Wan

See also: I2V · T2V · UMT5-XXL · LTX-2.5 · ping-pong

docs.title: LTX-2.5
docs.text:
LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot is the AV hero. Lab graphs load an audio VAE, concat empty audio latents with video latents, then decode audio into VHS so the MP4 has world sound. Landscape size is 1280×704 (VAE ÷32), not 1280×720. Accept the Hugging Face license and set HF_TOKEN before download-models. See Model licenses.

Also called: LTX

See also: joint AV · I2V · LTX Community License · gated model · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: Qwen3-4B
docs.text:
Klein stills encode prompts with qwen_3_4b as CLIP type flux2. Comfy wraps the string in a Qwen chat template — do not paste <|im_start|> into the widget. A separate Qwen3-4B-Instruct GGUF rewrites lazy sentences when Prompt Enhance is on (CPU-only). See Prompting.

Also called: qwen_3_4b, Qwen3

See also: Klein 4B · CLIP · GGUF · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: UMT5-XXL
docs.text:
Wan graphs load UMT5-XXL as CLIP type wan. T2V wants Entity + Scene + Motion + Aesthetic + one camera verb. I2V should drop look language so the start image stays in charge. See Prompting.

Also called: UMT5

See also: Wan 2.2 · CLIP · T2V · I2V

docs.title: Gemma 4
docs.text:
Seeded LTX graphs use CLIPLoader gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot with type ltxv. A DualCLIP or LTX-2.3 encoder on a 2.5 graph throws embedding-size errors. Write one present-tense paragraph with sound interleaved. See Prompting.

Also called: Gemma4

See also: LTX-2.5 · CLIP · joint AV

docs.title: ACE-Step
docs.text:
Native ACE-Step 1.5 ships in the Comfy pin. Podcast beds stay instrumental; rap graphs send original lyrics. download-music --tier turbo and download-podcast --tier acestep share the same AIO file. Occupancy: stop Klein/Wan/LTX first. See Local music and Local podcast.

Also called: ACE-Step 1.5

See also: occupancy · Kokoro · TTS

docs.title: Kokoro
docs.text:
Kokoro-82M is the US-safe default TTS (opt-in download-podcast --tier analog). Voices are stock identities, not clones of real people. The disclosure node prepends the spoken bumper so you do not type it. See Local podcast.

Also called: Kokoro-82M

See also: TTS · ACE-Step · disclosure bumper

docs.title: Chatterbox
docs.text:
Chatterbox Turbo is an opt-in TTS (download-podcast --tier chatterbox). Keep the PerTh watermark. Do not add celebrity reference WAVs. Kokoro remains the Spark-safe default. See Local podcast.

See also: Kokoro · TTS · Local dub

docs.title: Chatterbox Multilingual
docs.text:
Default engine for Local dub. Cross-lingual clone from a short ref extracted from this job, not a celebrity pack. Turbo English remains download-podcast --tier chatterbox.

Also called: Chatterbox Multilingual V3

See also: Chatterbox · Local dub · TTS

docs.title: CLIP
docs.text:
In this studio, “CLIP” means the model-specific text encoder: Qwen (flux2) for Klein, UMT5 (wan) for Wan, Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) for LTX. Wrong CLIP type is a common Queue failure. See Image and video generation.

See also: Qwen3-4B · UMT5-XXL · Gemma 4 · KSampler

docs.title: VAE
docs.text:
A VAE compresses an image or video into latents and decodes latents back to pixels (and, for LTX, audio). Mixing a Wan VAE with an LTX graph will fail. LTX also needs the audio VAE so joint AV latents are not length-zero. See Image and video generation.

See also: latent · LTX-2.5 · Klein 4B · Wan 2.2

docs.title: UNET
docs.text:
Comfy loaders still say UNET for many diffusion transformers, including Klein and Wan. The filename on the canvas must match a weight under MODELS_DIR. Lab graphs pin those names; do not swap in Klein 9B or FLUX.2-dev. See Models and cache.

See also: KSampler · latent · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: GGUF
docs.text:
download-models places Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf under comfy/llm/. Prompt Enhance runs it CPU-only (n_gpu_layers=0) so it does not fight LTX for GB10 memory. Missing GGUF is fail-soft: generation still runs. See Prompting.

See also: Prompt Enhance · Qwen3-4B · occupancy

docs.title: MagCache
docs.text:
MagCache skips some denoiser steps on the Wan 5 s smoke graph (extra.lab_magcache). Hero LTX prints and A14B graphs leave it off. If the node is missing, the Wan graph still Queues. See Workflow catalog.

See also: Wan 2.2 · I2V

docs.title: Nunchaku
docs.text:
LAB_VISUAL_ENABLE_NUNCHAKU=0. Seeded Klein graphs use core UNET/CLIP/VAE loaders. Do not pip install nunchaku from PyPI (that is a stats library). aarch64 Spark wheels are skip-by-default. See Troubleshooting.

See also: Klein 4B · UNET

docs.title: SeedVR2
docs.text:
SeedVR2-3B is a post-concat restore (download-restore --tier seedvr2-3b). Conservative 1.3–1.5× on the master only. Occupancy: stop Comfy first if you restore on GPU. See 90s shorts.

Also called: SeedVR2-3B

See also: occupancy · last-frame continuity

docs.title: TRELLIS.2
docs.text:
download-3d --tier trellis2 pulls TRELLIS.2 native weights only. Never pip-install nvdiffrast/nvdiffrec. Stop the Comfy stack before a heavy 3D job. See Studio sidecars.

Also called: TRELLIS

See also: sidecar · occupancy · DA3-BASE

docs.title: DA3-BASE
docs.text:
Depth Anything 3 BASE is the allowed depth sidecar weight. --tier da3-large is banned. Same occupancy rule as TRELLIS: one heavy GPU job. See Studio sidecars.

Also called: DA3

See also: TRELLIS.2 · occupancy

docs.title: LongCat-Video
docs.text:
download-longcat --tier video is opt-in. Context-parallel needs an explicit allow flag. Independent Sparks still share MODELS_DIR; this sample stack does not ship in-tree NCCL. See Spark farm.

Also called: LongCat

See also: Spark farm · Wan 2.2

docs.title: DreamX-Creator
docs.text:
download-dreamx --tier creator only. Unload LTX/Wan 5B first. Not a lab default and not a 90s printer. See Model licenses.

Also called: DreamX

See also: joint AV · LTX-2.5

docs.title: Fun InP
docs.text:
download-wan --tier fun-inp then load wan-flf-5s-lab-example. Unload LTX first. This is a continuity draft, not the 90s LTX print path. See 90s shorts.

See also: first-last-frame · Wan 2.2 · VACE

docs.title: VACE
docs.text:
VACE stitches the last frame of shot A toward the first frame of shot B as a short join clip. It is a Comfy graph, not a Docker sidecar. See Studio sidecars.

See also: Fun InP · last-frame continuity · Wan 2.2

docs.title: Z-Image Turbo
docs.text:
Z-Image Turbo uses different weights (ae, z_image_turbo_*). Seeded lab stills are Klein 4B. If a template asks for ae.safetensors, you loaded the wrong graph — open klein-still-draft-lab-example. Optional: download-image --tier zimage. See Model licenses.

Also called: Z-Image

See also: Klein 4B · T2I

docs.title: VideoHelperSuite
docs.text:
Wan and LTX lab graphs wire VHS_VideoCombine with save_output: true. After Queue, open Save video (MP4) — open node for preview. Files land on the host at COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR. LTX also feeds decoded audio into VHS. See Still to motion to AV.

Also called: VHS_VideoCombine, VHS

See also: LTX-2.5 · Wan 2.2 · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR

docs.title: Qwen3-TTS
docs.text:
download-podcast --tier qwen3tts is opt-in. Empty reference audio stays on Kokoro. Do not use it to clone a real person. See Local podcast.

See also: Kokoro · TTS

docs.title: FP8
docs.text:
FP8 keeps the default Klein 4B and several Wan files small enough for GB10. It is a storage/compute format, not a style. NVFP4 Klein is optional and still Apache for 4B. See Models and cache.

See also: Klein 4B · INT8-convrot

docs.title: INT8-convrot
docs.text:
Lab LTX-2.5 filenames include int8-convrot. If INT8-convrot or gated access fails, LTX-2.3 distilled FP8 is an optional fallback — seeded graphs still expect 2.5 names. See Models and cache.

See also: LTX-2.5 · FP8

docs.title: T2I
docs.text:
Text-to-image is the first studio move. Queue klein-still-draft-lab-example, then feed a PNG into Wan or LTX I2V if you want motion. See ComfyUI basics.

Also called: text-to-image

See also: Klein 4B · I2V · Queue

docs.title: I2V
docs.text:
Wan I2V is silent; LTX I2V can carry world audio. Point LoadImage at ez_still_draft_*.png (or a hero 1280×704 still for LTX). Do not re-describe wardrobe and location in an I2V prompt. See Klein, Wan, and LTX.

Also called: image-to-video

See also: T2V · LoadImage · Wan 2.2 · LTX-2.5

docs.title: T2V
docs.text:
Use T2V when you do not have a still you want to keep. Lab Wan T2V bypasses LoadImage. LTX T2V still wants a flowing paragraph with sound. See Prompting.

Also called: text-to-video

See also: I2V · Wan 2.2 · LTX-2.5

docs.title: A2V
docs.text:
klein-talking-head-lab-example smokes LTX A2V freeze. Banned lip-sync OSS (Wav2Lip) stays out. See Workflow catalog.

Also called: audio-to-video

See also: S2V · LTX-2.5

docs.title: S2V
docs.text:
Wan S2V is opt-in (download-wan --tier s2v) and occupancy-heavy. Talking-head lab graphs mention it; they do not require it for the LTX freeze smoke. See Model licenses.

Also called: speech-to-video

See also: A2V · Wan 2.2

docs.title: joint AV
docs.text:
LTX is a joint audio/video model. Lab graphs must build empty audio latents and concat them before KSampler. Omitting that path yields a reshape error on length-zero audio. Wan stays silent on purpose (cleaner Apache motion). See Klein, Wan, and LTX.

Also called: AV hero

See also: LTX-2.5 · Wan 2.2 · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: first-last-frame
docs.text:
FLF is a continuity draft: you pick how the shot starts and ends. It is optional and large. 90s films instead chain last-frame PNG → next I2V start. See 90s shorts.

Also called: FLF

See also: Fun InP · last-frame continuity · I2V

docs.title: ping-pong
docs.text:
wan-gif-loop-lab-example leaves VHS ping-pong on. Prompt cyclic motion (breeze, curtains), not a walk or one-way dolly, or reverse playback looks wrong. See Prompting.

See also: Wan 2.2 · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: Asset Bible
docs.text:
Each slug is an ez.asset.v1 record (kind, prompt, seed, pipeline, takes). scene.json instances slugs; it does not embed meshes. Gen is Klein still → TRELLIS.2. Construct is a shopping list of primitives + HDRI + bible refs. Operator verb today: asset-ls. See Asset Bible.

Also called: asset-bible

See also: Klein 4B · LTX-2.5 · TRELLIS.2

docs.title: ComfyUI
docs.text:
You operate the host with manage.sh; you use the studio in the browser at COMFY_PORT (default 8188). Graphs are nodes and widgets, not a chat box. Seeded files end in -lab-example and copy into user/default/workflows/ on start. App Mode graphs land as *.app.json so they appear under Apps as well as Workflows. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Queue · widget · workflow · manage.sh

docs.title: workflow
docs.text:
Host files live under workflows/*-lab-example.json. The entrypoint copies them into Comfy (*.app.json when App Mode is the default view). Do not edit raw JSON for daily use; type on the canvas. Every lab graph includes a Note node. See Workflow catalog.

Also called: node graph, lab graph

See also: lab-example · Note node · widget · ComfyUI

docs.title: Queue
docs.text:
Queue is the studio's play button. A still-draft Queue is minutes; a 5 s Wan/LTX Queue is minutes; a one-click 90s film Queue is 18 sequential 5 s prints (long wall-clock, not a 90s denoise). See ComfyUI basics.

See also: ComfyUI · KSampler · seed

docs.title: widget
docs.text:
Studio work is widget work: change the Positive prompt, seed, LoadImage filename, or Enhance toggle on the canvas. The JSON on disk stays the seeded lab example. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Queue · workflow · Enhance · App Mode

docs.title: App Mode
docs.text:
App Mode shows the creator widgets listed in extra.linearData (Prompt, Style, Rewrite prompt, seed; LoadImage on I2V; size/UNET only on the daily still). Persist is [nodeId, widgetName, config] with an integer node id — frontend 1.49.6+ upgrades that to a live WidgetId. Two-part 11:prompt ids are dropped and the side panel looks empty. It is not a second frontend. The lab contract is lab_app_mode. Multi-shot Apps expose one identity prompt, not per-shot cards. Film graphs may open in graph view. On start, App Mode graphs seed as *.app.json so they appear in Comfy's Apps sidebar as well as Workflows. See ComfyUI Apps and ComfyUI basics.

See also: lab_app_mode · widget · occupancy · workflow

docs.title: lab_app_mode
docs.text:
extra.lab_app_mode marks a seeded graph as an App (enabled, default_view, lane inspire/produce/audio/film/dcc, occupancy, handoff). default_view: app seeds as *.app.json (Apps + Workflows sidebars). Do not require extra.linearMode — Comfy upstream does not write it. See ComfyUI Apps.

See also: App Mode · occupancy · lab-example

docs.title: latent
docs.text:
5.00 s at 24 fps is 120 frames (some smokes use 121 = 4n+1). LTX spatial size must be divisible by 32 — lab landscape is 1280×704. Do not Queue a 30–90 s latent on GB10. See Image and video generation.

Also called: latent space

See also: VAE · KSampler · LTX-2.5

docs.title: KSampler
docs.text:
Distilled Klein uses 4 steps and CFG 1.0. Wan/LTX lab graphs pin steps, scheduler, and frame count on the canvas. Changing those widgets is how you experiment; changing them to a 90 s denoise is how you melt the Spark. See Image and video generation.

Also called: sampler

See also: CFG · seed · latent · Queue

docs.title: CFG
docs.text:
CFG 1.0 on distilled Klein means the positive prompt is the whole game. FLUX-family models do not use negatives well; put constraints in the positive (“unmarked facades”). See Prompting.

See also: Klein 4B · KSampler

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Fix a seed when you iterate a prompt so lighting and identity do not jump. Identity sheets pin seed 42. Random seeds are for discovery, not for matching a still into I2V. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Queue · identity still

docs.title: Prompt Enhance
docs.text:
Klein/Wan/LTX Prompt Enhance defaults on for lazy CLIP printers and identity bibles you type. Seeded graphs pin it off for 90s films, talking-head, loops, camera-verb I2V, podcast scripts, and ACE tags/lyrics so the rewriter cannot mutate those inputs. The CLIP prompt box is visible on the node; after Queue it is the encoded string. Fail-soft if the GGUF is missing. See Prompting.

See also: Enhance · GGUF · Qwen3-4B

docs.title: world bible
docs.text:
Dream-house and style-lock graphs keep massing, materials, and inventory in a bible. Shot cards add a new camera (lock=view) or change only light (lock=state). Each view shot names its own room backdrop so interiors do not reuse one skyline. Identity-mode enhance keeps the bible camera-free. See Prompting.

See also: identity still · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: identity still
docs.text:
90s films Queue a Klein identity at 1280×704 (LTX grid), then 18 LTX prints that start from last frames. Enhance stays off so the rewriter cannot restyle the bible. See 90s shorts.

See also: Klein 4B · world bible · last-frame continuity

docs.title: lab-example
docs.text:
If it does not end in -lab-example, it is not a lab smoke. Optional packs live under workflows/optional/ and workflows/shorts/. See Workflow catalog.

Also called: lab-example graphs

See also: workflow · Note node

docs.title: Note node
docs.text:
Every seeded graph includes a Comfy Note plus extra.lab_note. Read it before you Queue. It is the UI source of truth when docs and widgets disagree after a pull. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: lab-example · workflow

docs.title: LoadImage
docs.text:
After a still-draft Queue, set Wan/LTX LoadImage to ez_still_draft_*.png under COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR (the container sees /outputs). Leaving example.png is a smoke test only. See Still to motion to AV.

See also: I2V · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR

docs.title: Enhance
docs.text:
Enhance defaults on for every lab graph. Turn it off to pin widget text. Identity mode keeps world bibles camera-free. I2V / FLF / VACE ignore style — the start frames own look. See Prompting.

See also: Prompt Enhance · world bible

docs.title: Guide pack
docs.text:
The DCC ↔ Comfy print handshake. Lives under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/guides/<slug>/<shot>/. Size is the LTX VAE grid (1280×704 or 768×1280, never 1280×720). 120 frames @ 24 fps. Workbench clay + mist depth + outline canny. Occupancy XOR: stop Comfy before export-guides. See DCC guide pack.

Also called: guide pack, guide-pack, DCC guide pack

See also: LTX-2.5 · occupancy · sidecar

docs.title: house-views
docs.text:
Host Blender constructs a bpy-primitive set under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/assets/sets/<slug>/ (layout, GLB, clay, depth). Size is Instagram 4:5 (1024×1280), not the LTX guide pack. Stop Comfy first for the dump. manage.sh start seeds LoadImage plates (copy pack or render layout) so klein-dream-house-clay-lab-example can Queue without Blender. Language-only tour → klein-dream-house-lab-example. See Dream-house tours.

Also called: dream-house clay, clay tour

See also: Guide pack · occupancy · sidecar · Klein 4B

docs.title: blender-stills
docs.text:
Host Blender dumps ez.guide.still.v1 under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/guides/<slug>/stills/<plate>/. Sizes: 1280×704, 768×1280, 1024×1280, 1024×1024, 1280×720 (thumb, not LTX). Not the 5.00s shot pack and not house-views. Stop Comfy first. --install-inputs copies first.png into input/ while compose may stay up. Apps: klein-from-clay-plates, klein-from-canny. See Blender creator suite.

Also called: still pack, ez.guide.still.v1

See also: Guide pack · house-views · occupancy · sidecar · Klein 4B

docs.title: DGX Spark
docs.text:
ez-comfy-stack is a sample studio for a single DGX Spark. Independent Sparks may share MODELS_DIR (Spark farm) but there is no in-tree NCCL. SSH recoverability drives restart: no, headroom, and download-limit. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

Also called: Spark

See also: GB10 · headroom · Spark farm · restart: no

docs.title: GB10
docs.text:
There is no separate giant VRAM pool. Compose mem_limit is 90g so the host keeps headroom for SSH. One heavy job at a time. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: unified memory · headroom · occupancy

docs.title: unified memory
docs.text:
The stack applies patch_unified_memory_copy.py (copy=False on safetensor .to(device)) and patch_get_free_memory.py (host free RAM instead of under-reporting cudaMemGetInfo). --highvram is the wrong flag here. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: GB10 · headroom · Comfy Kitchen

docs.title: occupancy
docs.text:
GB10 is one GPU. Stop compose before host Blender/NVENC/proxies. Do not load Klein + Wan + LTX + ACE-Step in one session. Cover art is a separate graph. App occupancy keys (none/llm/klein/wan/ltx/film/audio) are on every App Note — stop the other family before Queue. See ComfyUI Apps and Studio sidecars.

See also: sidecar · ACE-Step · GB10 · App Mode

docs.title: headroom
docs.text:
doctor and start refuse when host free RAM is below policy (min_host_free_gib). Do not weaken this for demos. See Reboot safety and Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: restart: no · doctor · unified memory

docs.title: restart: no
docs.text:
A remotely managed Spark that relaunches a 90g GPU job on boot is how you lose SSH. Always manage.sh stop before reboot. Independent farm nodes use the same policy. See Reboot safety.

Also called: restart: "no"

See also: headroom · manage.sh · DGX Spark

docs.title: download-limit
docs.text:
Full-rate multi-GB pulls freeze SSH. download-models wraps wondershaper when HTB works, else gentler HF workers. DOWNLOAD_LIMIT=off is an SSH risk. See Download limit.

Also called: download limit

See also: HTB · headroom · MODELS_DIR · --tier

docs.title: --tier
docs.text:
download-models has no --tier. Image fast, Wan 5b, and LTX 2.5 are three different pack ids that happen to be the lab defaults. Wan --tier all does not include vace or s2v. See Download tiers.

See also: download-models · download-limit · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: download-models
docs.text:
Does not pull podcast, music, 3D, LongCat, DreamX, or SeedVR2. Those are opt-in utilities with their own --tier pack ids. Throttled by download-limit. See Download tiers and Models and cache.

See also: --tier · download-limit · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: disk-wizard
docs.text:
Surveys MODELS_DIR junk, Hugging Face hub cache, Docker build cache, Ollama/vLLM leftovers, and other experiment residue on a Spark that runs more than this studio. --plan is read-only. Review-class items quarantine. Never docker system prune -a --volumes. cleanup still only removes the comfy-state volume. See Disk wizard.

Also called: disk wizard

See also: quarantine · MODELS_DIR · download-models

docs.title: quarantine
docs.text:
reap-models --quarantine and disk-wizard review-class actions move files to a timestamped tree with a JSONL manifest. Restore with the matching restore --from command. Junk class may delete in place. See Disk wizard.

See also: disk-wizard · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: HTB
docs.text:
When sch_htb is absent, downloads continue with a warning and gentler Hugging Face settings. That is not a license to set DOWNLOAD_LIMIT=off. See Download limit.

Also called: wondershaper

See also: download-limit

docs.title: MODELS_DIR
docs.text:
Weights live on the host so GHCR images stay small and multiple stacks can share one cache. cleanup does not delete MODELS_DIR. See Models and cache.

See also: comfy-state · GHCR · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR

docs.title: COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR
docs.text:
cleanup does not delete outputs. status prints the path. Look here after Queue, not inside the git repo. See Getting Started.

See also: MODELS_DIR · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: comfy-state
docs.text:
First start seeds the volume from /opt/comfy-prebuilt. Weights are not in this volume. Resetting it does not re-download Klein/Wan/LTX. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: GHCR · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: GHCR
docs.text:
main → ghcr.io/toxicoder/ez-comfy:us-safe-studio; development and feature branches → -development. The image has Comfy+torch, not Klein/Wan/LTX weights. Old flux-to-ltx* tags freeze. See Getting Started.

See also: comfy-state · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: US-safe
docs.text:
Defaults: Apache Klein 4B + Apache Wan 2.2 + LTX-2.5 Community (gated, $10M cap). MiniMax H3 is a US Excluded Territory ban for weights and outputs. Read Model licenses before a 30 GB pull.

See also: LTX Community License · Apache 2.0 · MiniMax H3

docs.title: manage.sh
docs.text:
Run from the repo root. It loads .env. Studio users still Queue in the browser; operators keep SSH alive with this tool. Full catalog: manage.sh reference.

See also: doctor · restart: no · download-limit

docs.title: doctor
docs.text:
Fix hard doctor failures before download-models. Missing lab weights are a warning, not a hard fail. attention: pytorch-fallback on a running Spark is a 10–20× slow path. See Troubleshooting.

See also: manage.sh · headroom · Comfy Kitchen

docs.title: HF_TOKEN
docs.text:
Klein 4B and Wan 5B are Apache. LTX-2.5 still needs you to open the model card as that user and click Agree. Fine-grained tokens need gated-repo read. See Model licenses.

See also: gated model · LTX-2.5

docs.title: gated model
docs.text:
A token in .env is not the same as accepting the Lightricks license. download-models exits non-zero until the distilled LTX set is on disk. See Getting Started.

Also called: gated repo

See also: HF_TOKEN · LTX-2.5 · LTX Community License

docs.title: Comfy Kitchen
docs.text:
doctor prints attention: kitchen|sage|pytorch-fallback|unknown. Never pass --use-sage-attention next to Kitchen. spark-timing refuses to record unless Kitchen is live. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

Also called: Kitchen attention

See also: pytorch-fallback · doctor

docs.title: pytorch-fallback
docs.text:
If doctor says attention: pytorch-fallback while compose is up, do not record spark-timing and do not treat mushy video as a prompt problem. See Troubleshooting.

See also: Comfy Kitchen

docs.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit
docs.text:
setup --install-docker configures nvidia-ctk when present. Snap Docker is the wrong install. See Getting Started.

See also: DGX Spark · manage.sh

docs.title: last-frame continuity
docs.text:
18 × 5.00 s LTX prints (120 frames @ 24 fps) stitch to a 90.00 s cap. One-click film graphs chain this inside Comfy; print-shot / film-resume do it on the host jobstore. See 90s shorts.

See also: identity still · LTX-2.5 · film-accept

docs.title: OTIO
docs.text:
manage.sh film-export-otio go-see writes stdlib JSON under films/<slug>/publish/. Import on the Spark host or a laptop. Occupancy: stop Comfy if the NLE will use the GPU. See Studio sidecars.

See also: sidecar · jobstore

docs.title: NVENC
docs.text:
film-proxies and nvenc-preview.sh refuse while compose is up. They never rewrite masters. See 90s shorts.

See also: occupancy · film-accept

docs.title: film-accept
docs.text:
manage.sh film-accept go-see (and concat --film --yes) refuse shots that drift. --skip-accept is an escape hatch, not a default. See 90s shorts.

See also: last-frame continuity · LTX-2.5

docs.title: jobstore
docs.text:
A dropped SSH session is not a two-hour requeue: film-resume skips ok 5.00 s shots. Optional studio-ui on :8190 is lights only (no GPU). See 90s shorts.

See also: last-frame continuity · film-accept

docs.title: Shot card
docs.text:
shot-sheet writes films/<slug>/shots.yaml with fail-closed defaults (clay: skip, audio_policy: world-only). Lab workflows/shorts/*.shots.yaml stay golden fixtures. See Clay to finish.

Also called: shot card, shot-card

See also: Guide pack · film-accept

docs.title: overlay-qc
docs.text:
Host ffmpeg; compose may stay up. Writes overlay.png and score.json. Human still picks; the score only ranks. See Clay to finish.

Also called: overlay QC

See also: Guide pack · occupancy

docs.title: film-animatic
docs.text:
manage.sh film-animatic --film go-see concats clay clips or 5.00 s still holds, cap 90 s. Not a 90 s denoise. See Clay to finish.

Also called: animatic

See also: Guide pack · Shot card

docs.title: loudnorm
docs.text:
podcast-loudnorm.sh is a hard fail if ffmpeg is missing — it will not skip. 90s publish graphs apply YouTube loudnorm in EZFilmConcat. See Local podcast.

See also: TTS · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: sidecar
docs.text:
Sidecars stay off the Docker image on purpose. manage.sh blender dies if compose is up. See Studio sidecars.

See also: occupancy · TRELLIS.2

docs.title: Spark farm
docs.text:
Farm mode Queues different beats on different hosts. Concat stays on one machine. spark-farm.sh never starts compose on a remote node (each node still types yes locally). See Spark farm.

See also: DGX Spark · MODELS_DIR · restart: no

docs.title: concat-shots
docs.text:
concat-shots.sh --film go-see --yes is the host fallback. It writes a faststart H.264 master plus ez_*_90s.html. --xfade is audio-only and refuses Wan-silent shots. See 90s shorts.

See also: last-frame continuity · film-accept

docs.title: Local dub
docs.text:
The dub-localize-lab-example App transcribes with faster-whisper (segments become turns), clusters speakers with Chatterbox ve.pt, writes per-speaker clone refs, translates each turn with the on-box GGUF (ISO source → target), and clones each voice (Chatterbox Multilingual V3, language_id like es). Pick or upload a file from input/ (or set a Source URL). I have rights must be on. Occupancy audio. After Queue, Dub status lists speaker/turn counts. Missing ASR/clone yields an empty mix plus that status, not the original recording. Wheels install separately (chatterbox --no-deps so torch 2.14 stays). YouTube Studio wants the audio-only ez_dub_yt file, not a muxed multi-track MP4. See Local dub.

Also called: dub-localize

See also: Chatterbox · TTS · occupancy · disclosure bumper · YouTube multi-language audio

docs.title: YouTube multi-language audio
docs.text:
YouTube does not reliably ingest extra AAC tracks muxed into an MP4. Export ez_dub_yt.wav, upload it under Languages → Audio, add the translated SRT, and use the synthetic/altered-content toggle. Eligibility varies by channel. See Local dub.

Also called: multi-language audio, MLA

See also: Local dub · loudnorm

docs.title: stem-mix
docs.text:
LTX joint AV is the world bed, not the master. Occupancy audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX first. film-accept checks stem LUFS when audio_policy: stems. See Clay to finish.

Also called: audio finish

See also: loudnorm · film-accept

docs.title: audio-still-video
docs.text:
Post-Queue export only. Rap / podcast / dub graphs still save FLAC + MP3. manage.sh audio-still-video --audio FILE --image FILE loops the still (libx264, 1920×1080 letterbox default, AAC, +faststart). CPU encode; compose may stay up. Missing ffmpeg is a hard fail. See Local music.

See also: loudnorm

docs.title: TTS
docs.text:
Invented characters only. Disclose synthetic voices in the mix (spoken bumper), not only in a description box. TTS-Audio-Suite and celebrity refs are out of policy. See Local podcast.

See also: Kokoro · disclosure bumper · ACE-Step

docs.title: disclosure bumper
docs.text:
Do not type the bumper yourself — EZPodcastDisclosure prepends it. Platform and USCO rules still apply; this page is not legal advice. See Local podcast.

See also: TTS · Kokoro

docs.title: Apache 2.0
docs.text:
Apache still + Apache silent motion is why the daily driver is legally the cleanest motion path. LTX is not Apache. This is policy text, not legal advice. See Model licenses.

Also called: Apache

See also: Klein 4B · Wan 2.2 · LTX Community License · US-safe

docs.title: LTX Community License
docs.text:
No US geo-ban on the Community License, but the company-revenue cap counts affiliates. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance. Not legal advice. See Model licenses.

Also called: Community License

See also: LTX-2.5 · gated model · US-safe

docs.title: MiniMax H3
docs.text:
Do not download, Queue, or pin Comfy for MiniMax H3. doctor warns if leftover weights exist. Use the US-safe Klein/Wan/LTX pack instead. See Model licenses.

See also: US-safe · Klein 4B

docs.title: Model licenses
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Who this policy is for (US casual commercial, local weights only)
  • Canonical table (same rows as repo-root LICENSE-MODELS.md)
  • What we download by default vs omit
  • LTX $10M company-revenue cap vs Wan Apache silent video
  • How 90s shorts split Klein still / optional silent Wan / LTX AV print
  • What is banned (MiniMax H3, MiniMax Music 3, Suno/Udio, Klein 9B, FLUX.2-dev, API-only)

What this enables

  • A grep-able policy CI can test
  • Honest copy: LTX is the audio model and is not Apache; Wan is the legally cleanest motion model and has no native audio
  • Operators can Queue the lab graphs without pulling US-excluded or non-commercial defaults

Not legal advice

This page encodes the stack’s download and workflow policy. It is not legal advice. Read each Hugging Face model card and license before you monetize. Company-revenue caps (LTX) count affiliates.

docs.title: Defaults vs gated vs banned
docs.text:
Bucket Meaning Default download Klein 4B still (Apache) + Wan 2.2 silent (Apache) + LTX-2.5 AV (LTX Community License, gated, $10M company cap) + Prompt Enhance GGUF Gated LTX-2.5 (LTX Community License): token and a license click as that Hugging Face user Opt-in Podcast (Kokoro, ACE-Step), rap AIO, Z-Image, Wan A14B, Fun InP, TRELLIS.2, … Banned MiniMax H3 (US Excluded Territory for weights and outputs), Klein 9B as default, FLUX.2-dev as default, cloud partner APIs, NC TTS packs 
flowchart LR
  D["Apache still + Apache silent"] --> Daily["Daily driver"]
  G["LTX Community · gated"] --> AV["AV hero"]
  B["H3 / 9B default / APIs"] --> No["Not in this lab"]

docs.title: Audience
docs.text: US-based casual content creators: YouTube, client shorts, ads under a small LLC. Run only locally hosted models. No fal / Comfy Cloud / MiniMax API / Kling / Seedance / Veo partner nodes in lab graphs.

docs.title: Before download-models
docs.text:
LTX-2.5 is gated. Klein 4B and Wan 5B are Apache and do not need a license click.

  1. Create or edit .env with HF_TOKEN=hf_... (or hf auth login)
  2. In a browser, as that same user, open https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5 and click Agree
  3. Fine-grained tokens need gated repo read
  4. ./scripts/manage.sh download-models (hf is auto-installed; token in .env is enough — no extra hf auth login if HF_TOKEN is set)

A token in .env is not the same as accepting the Lightricks license. First-run path: Getting Started.

docs.title: Why these defaults
docs.text:
Still (Apache 2.0): FLUX.2 Klein 4B distilled FP8 is the official ComfyUI Klein 4B path (flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, qwen_3_4b.safetensors, flux2-vae.safetensors). Distilled = 4 steps, CFG 1.0. Klein 9B is FLUX Non-Commercial — not fine for monetized YouTube as a lab default. FLUX.2 [dev] is not a casual-commercial default.

Runner-up still: Z-Image Turbo (Apache 2.0, native Comfy templates). Optional download-image --tier zimage if Klein 4B quality disappoints. Qwen-Image is the slower quality sibling — documented only, not a default download.

Silent motion (Apache 2.0): Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B is the daily driver (T2V + I2V, official Comfy templates). No native audio. Wan 2.2 A14B is an optional hero (download-wan --tier a14b), not the first download.

Audio + video (not Apache): LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot is the AV hero. LTX Community License: free commercial under $10M COMPANY annual revenue (affiliates count); no US geo-ban; disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill into a competing model. Hugging Face repo is gated — accept the license and set HF_TOKEN before download-models. Lab download is the small distilled set, not the 400 GB monorepo.

LTX-2.3: optional fallback (download-ltx --tier 2.3) if 2.5 access or INT8-convrot fails. Not advertised as 30 s / 60 s films.

90s films: Klein identity still + 18 × LTX 5.00s print (world audio, no score), stitch with a 90s cap. Do not Queue a 90s latent. See 90s shorts.

Omitted: LongCat-Video (custom-node risk). HunyuanVideo 1.5 (US-legal but territorial clause for other countries — not the one-stack default).

docs.title: Banned
docs.text:
Do not download, do not reference in lab graphs, do not pin Comfy for them:

  • MiniMax H3 (US Excluded Territory for weights and outputs)
  • MiniMax Music 3 as a lab default

Who this is for: operators who already cloned the repo. First install: Getting Started.

docs.title: Models & Cache
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Default cache location and layout
  • Host persistence (weights, media, Comfy user/, operator custom nodes)
  • Download utilities, auto-install of hf, resume / stuck-partial recovery, and readiness checks
  • Pointer: --tier is a pack id (Download tiers)
  • Prebuilt image layer-cache contract (what invalidates multi‑GB pulls)
  • Volume Comfy pin (.lab-comfyui-ref) vs image COMFYUI_REF
  • Sharing with nvidia-dgx-spark-lab

What this enables

  • Downloading weights once and reusing them across stacks
  • Checking readiness without network access
  • Rebuilding/pulling only the layers that actually changed

Operator path

Most operators only need: set MODELS_DIR → download-models → confirm basenames. Layer pins and Dockerfile cache order are for maintainers — collapsed below.

docs.title: Three stores
docs.text:
Store Holds Not held here GHCR image ComfyUI + PyTorch Klein / Wan / LTX weights MODELS_DIR Weights + comfy/ relative symlinks The Comfy venv comfy-state volume Comfy install, lab ez_* custom nodes Host PNGs/MP4s, start images, Comfy user/, operator _user node packs (COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR)

cleanup (type DELETE) removes comfy-state only. Generated media, LoadImage start frames (${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/input), Comfy user workflows (${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/comfy-user), and operator custom nodes (${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/custom-nodes-user) stay on the host. Concepts: Hardware, memory, and safety.

docs.title: Persistence (survives stop / image pull)
docs.text:
What Host Container On start Model weights ${MODELS_DIR:-/mnt/models} /models persist Generated PNG/MP4/audio ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR:-/mnt/comfy-output} /outputs persist LoadImage inputs ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/input /inputs persist Comfy user/ (sidebar, history) ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/comfy-user /comfy-state/ComfyUI/user persist Live lab graphs …/comfy-user/default/workflows/_lab/ same overwrite from repo workflows/ (or workflows/_lab/ when present) Live operator graphs …/comfy-user/default/workflows/_user/ same never touch Other files under live workflows same tree same never touch Lab custom nodes ez_* git custom_nodes/ $COMFY_HOME/custom_nodes/ez_* overwrite Operator custom nodes ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/custom-nodes-user $COMFY_HOME/custom_nodes/_user persist (pin refresh excludes this tree) Comfy install + venv Docker volume ez-comfy-state /comfy-state persist until cleanup

seed_from_prebuilt already skips user/, input/, output/, temp/, and extra_model_paths.yaml. It also skips custom_nodes/_user/ so a pin refresh cannot delete Manager-installed packs that live on the host bind. Lab packs named ez_* still overwrite from /opt/ez-comfy/custom_nodes.

docs.title: Default location
docs.text:
export MODELS_DIR="${MODELS_DIR:-/mnt/models}"

Override in .env if needed. Prefer a large, durable disk on the Spark.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text:
doctor requires MODELS_DIR to be writable by the current user (check only; no sudo). Nested ${MODELS_DIR}/comfy can still be root-owned after a container start — that is a warning, not a hard doctor failure.

setup, download-models, and start sudo-heal ${MODELS_DIR}/comfy and each layout subdir (and the dest dir of each relative symlink) when they are not writable. They do not recurse chown over HF snapshots under MODELS_DIR. Do not prefix download-models with sudo (download-limit uses sudo internally; hf must stay on the login user's PATH).

Preferred (setup / download-models)Manual last resortHome path 
./scripts/manage.sh setup
./scripts/manage.sh download-models
# sudo mkdir -p + chown for MODELS_DIR and MODELS_DIR/comfy when needed

sudo mkdir -p "${MODELS_DIR}/comfy"
sudo chown -R "$USER:$USER" "${MODELS_DIR}/comfy"

# .env
MODELS_DIR=$HOME/models

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
Each utility writes to ${MODELS_DIR}/<org__repo>_<tier> (tier_dir), then relative symlinks into comfy/:

${MODELS_DIR}/
  black-forest-labs__FLUX.2-klein-4b-fp8_fast/
  Comfy-Org__z_image_turbo_te/                # qwen_3_4b
  Comfy-Org__flux2-dev_vae/                   # flux2-vae
  Comfy-Org__Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged_5b/
  Lightricks__LTX-2.5_2.5/
  unsloth__Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF_llm/
  comfy/
    diffusion_models/   # relative symlinks into tier repos above
    text_encoders/
    vae/
    llm/                # Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M GGUF
    onnx/               # opt-in Kokoro ONNX (download-podcast --tier analog) + Silero VAD (download-dub)
    tts/                # opt-in Kokoro voices + Chatterbox / Qwen3-TTS / Chatterbox ML V3
    whisper/            # opt-in faster-whisper large-v3 (download-dub --tier asr)
    checkpoints/        # opt-in ACE-Step 1.5 AIO (download-music --tier turbo / download-podcast --tier acestep)
  hub/                  # HF cache (optional)

Host-wide leftovers (HF hub, Docker layers, Ollama, other inference backends) are not reap-models — use disk-wizard (--plan first). When the default pack moves (LTX 2.3 → 2.5 already happened), reap the old tree — do not wait for disk-full:

./scripts/manage.sh models-status
./scripts/manage.sh reap-models --plan
./scripts/manage.sh reap-models --apply --class junk --yes
./scripts/manage.sh reap-models --apply --class superseded --quarantine --yes

Opt-in packs (not download-models):

./scripts/utilities/download-wan.sh run --tier fun-inp   # Fun InP A14B FLF, ~47 GB Apache
./scripts/manage.sh download-restore --tier seedvr2-3b   # SeedVR2-3B post-concat, ~15 GB Apache
./scripts/manage.sh download-3d --tier trellis2          # native TRELLIS.2 MIT, no nvdiffrast
./scripts/manage.sh download-3d --tier da3-base          # DA3-BASE Apache (DA3-LARGE refused)
./scripts/utilities/download-wan.sh run --tier vace      # Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B join, ~6 GB Apache
./scripts/utilities/download-wan.sh run --tier a14b      # A14B FP8 silent hero; unload 5B first
./scripts/utilities/download-wan.sh run --tier s2v       # S2V-14B talking-head opt-in
./scripts/manage.sh download-longcat --tier video        # LongCat-Video MIT; no NCCL
./scripts/manage.sh download-dreamx --tier creator       # DreamX-Creator 1.0 Apache; not World

Unload LTX before Fun InP / TRELLIS / VACE. SeedVR2 is restore-only after concat. reap-models --drop-pack cannot eat shared VAEs. SuperSplat is a host viewer, not a download.

manage.sh cleanup is volume-only (named volume comfy-state). It does not delete weights. reap-models --plan is the default; --apply requires --yes. Shared files (flux2-vae, ACE-Step AIO) stay in the keep-set so --drop-pack cannot eat them.

download-models links weights into comfy/* with relative symlinks (e.g. ../../Comfy-Org__flux2-dev_vae/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors). That way the same tree resolves on the host (MODELS_DIR=/mnt/models) and inside the container (bind-mounted at /models). Absolute /mnt/models/… file links look fine on the host but break Comfy with “exists but doesn't link anywhere”.

This matches the lab hostPath pattern so K8s and Docker demos can share weights.

flowchart TB
  Root["MODELS_DIR"]
  Root --> Klein["black-forest-labs__FLUX.2-klein-4b-fp8_fast"]
  Root --> TE["Comfy-Org__z_image_turbo_te"]
  Root --> VAE["Comfy-Org__flux2-dev_vae"]
  Root --> Wan["Comfy-Org__Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged_5b"]
  Root --> Ltx["Lightricks__LTX-2.5_2.5"]
  Root --> Llm["unsloth__Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF_llm"]
  Root --> Comfy["comfy/"]
  Root --> Hub["hub/ · optional HF cache"]
  Comfy --> DM["diffusion_models/ · symlinks"]
  Comfy --> TEd["text_encoders/"]
  Comfy --> VAEd["vae/"]
  Comfy --> LlmDir["llm/"]
  Comfy --> Onnx["onnx/ · opt-in Kokoro"]
  Comfy --> Tts["tts/ · opt-in voices"]
  Comfy --> Ckpt["checkpoints/ · opt-in ACE-Step AIO"]

docs.title: Download
docs.text:
download-models has no --tier. It always pulls the default still + Wan 5B + LTX-2.5 set. On every other downloader, --tier is which pack, not a global quality ladder. --limit is Mbps. Full flag map and live builders: Download tiers.

./scripts/manage.sh download-models
# Exits non-zero until every lab basename under MODELS_DIR/comfy is present
# Klein TE + flux2-vae use file-level readiness so a TE-only
# partial cannot cache-hit skip the VAE.

./scripts/manage.sh download-models --limit auto

Per-utility status (read-only) still uses the default pack ids:

./scripts/utilities/download-image.sh status --tier fast --json
./scripts/utilities/download-wan.sh status --tier 5b --json
./scripts/utilities/download-ltx.sh status --tier 2.5 --json
./scripts/utilities/download-llm.sh run

--tier fast also pulls Klein companions (te + vae). Opt-in packs (Wan A14B, Fun InP, LTX 2.3, music, podcast, 3D, …) live on Download tiers.

Downloads use the modern hf download CLI (not deprecated huggingface-cli). setup and download-models auto-install it into ~/.local/bin (or the original user's home when the command is run with sudo). Do not prefix download-models with sudo — download-limit uses sudo internally.

Progress UI is owned by the stack (disk size + MiB/s + elapsed on one line). Hub/tqdm file-count bars are disabled so they do not smash the heartbeat. HF_PROGRESS=0 turns progress lines off; HF_PROGRESS_INTERVAL=10 sets the tick (seconds).

docs.title: Gated models / HF_TOKEN
docs.text:
LTX-2.5 (Lightricks/LTX-2.5) is gated. Klein 4B distilled and Wan 2.2 5B are Apache and do not need a license click. A token in .env is not the same as accepting the Lightricks license.

# .env
HF_TOKEN=hf_...
# Browser, same account: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5 → Agree
# or: hf auth login
hf auth whoami

Fine-grained tokens need gated repo read. download-models passes --token from HF_TOKEN so it wins over a leftover hf auth login.

docs.title: Disk headroom
docs.text: manage.sh doctor / start require free disk ≥ MIN_DISK_FREE_GIB (default 40).

docs.title: LTX selective download
docs.text:
Default 2.5 is the small distilled set from Lightricks/LTX-2.5 (status min_gb 30).

Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy is a multi-variant hub repo (~400 GB if you pull everything). Use it only as a 2.3 fallback:

Tier Transformer (approx) Plus Total (approx) 2.5 (default) LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot Gemma4-with-proj + video/audio VAEs status floor ~30 GB 2.3 / balanced distilled FP8 …fp8_input_scaled_v3 (~25 GB) text projection + video/audio VAE + Gemma 3 TE ~28–30 GB + ~9.5 GB TE quality distilled BF16 (~42 GB) same projection + VAEs + Gemma 3 ~45–48 GB + TE gemma (auto with 2.3/balanced/quality) — gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed from Comfy-Org/ltx-2 ~9.5 GB

Lab LTX-2.5 graphs use CLIPLoader (Gemma4-with-proj, type ltxv). LTX-2.3 DualCLIP is fallback only — seeded lab JSON still names 2.5 files.

status --json readiness uses min_gb 30 (2.5) / 20 (2.3/balanced) / 35 (quality) / 8 (gemma) as a floor, not the full monorepo size.

Cleanup extra LTX monorepo files

If an older run pulled the full Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy snapshot into a 2.3/balanced/quality local-dir, reclaim disk by deleting everything outside the selective keep set:

# Preview (default)
./scripts/utilities/download-ltx.sh cleanup --tier 2.3

# Delete extras (keeps FP8 transformer + TE + VAEs only)
./scripts/utilities/download-ltx.sh cleanup --tier 2.3 --yes

Does not touch Klein, Wan, or other trees under MODELS_DIR.

Full monorepo escape hatch

Operators who really want every precision/lora:

LTX_FULL_REPO=1 ./scripts/utilities/download-ltx.sh run --tier 2.3

After a full-repo mistake, use cleanup --yes instead of wiping all of MODELS_DIR.

Downloads are resumable and cacheable under MODELS_DIR:

Behavior Detail Resume after interrupt Ctrl+C / crash leaves *.incomplete under each tier’s .cache/huggingface/; re-run the same command to continue Resume stall (0 MiB/s) Live hf holding a lock with no disk growth. After 90s the downloader drops that dest’s partials and retries once. Skip when ready download-image / download-wan / download-ltx skip tiers that already have required weights (log: cache hit) HF_HOME Set to MODELS_DIR so hub metadata lives on the durable model disk Cleanup download-ltx.sh cleanup --yes removes non-selective monorepo weights but keeps .cache/, *.incomplete, and selective keep-set files

Keep .cache/

Do not delete a tier’s .cache/huggingface/ folder if you want fast resume/metadata checks. Finished weight files are never re-downloaded unless missing or hub revision changes.

docs.title: Image layer cache (high-velocity rebuilds + pulls)
docs.text:
Layer invalidation matrix

Dockerfile order is intentional so ops-script edits do not re-download multi‑GB torch, Comfy/node pip does not re-pull torch, and runtime apt changes rebase via COPY --link:

Change Rebuild multi‑GB torch stage? Re-pull venv-torch? Re-pull venv-extra? Re-pull app? entrypoint.sh / UM patches / orchestrator No No No No install-comfy/common.sh (clone/link/strip only) No No No Maybe (nodes/comfy stages) install-comfy/phase-nodes.sh or node sources only No No No Yes (smaller) VideoHelperSuite / new node pip deps (opencv, llama-cpp, …) No No Yes (delta only) Yes install-comfy/phase-comfy.sh / COMFYUI_REF bump No No Yes if reqs change Yes install-comfy/core.sh / phase-venv-torch.sh / TORCH_VERSION Yes Yes Yes Yes Runtime apt only (gcc/g++/python3-dev for Triton JIT) No No (COPY --link) No No

Builder: named stages torch → comfy → nodes. Torch COPY is only core.sh + phase-venv-torch.sh. Pin ARGs are declared in the stage that uses them. Runtime: COPY --link /opt/parts/venv then venv-extra then app (then thin ops scripts). Compose bind-mounts entrypoint.sh, install-comfy.sh, install-comfy/, pythonpath/, and the UM patches so local script iteration needs no image rebuild.

Runtime installs gcc + g++ + python3-dev (not full build-essential) so PyTorch 2.13+ Triton can JIT-compile cuda_utils (needs CC + Python.h) on first CLIPTextEncode. That is a small apt layer; COPY --link keeps the multi‑GB torch blob. If JIT deps are still incomplete, the entrypoint sets LAB_DISABLE_TORCH_NATIVE_TRITON=1 so torch falls back to eager/cuBLAS.

venv-extra is the pip delta after the torch snapshot (Comfy requirements.txt, Manager/VHS, llama-cpp). Baking a small optional wheel (e.g. kokoro-onnx) invalidates extra, not torch.

docs.title: Prebuild version pins (validated)
docs.text:
Pin table and bump procedure

Defaults are intentional tags so GHCR rebuilds are reproducible. Validated 2026-07-29 (Comfy pin 2026-09-08):

Pin Default Why this value TORCH_VERSION 2.14.0 cu130 aarch64 wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130. Declared only in the torch stage. Bump here (and compose / publish-image / install-comfy/core.sh) when rebuilding the multi‑GB layer. COMFYUI_REF v0.34.6 Newest patch tag on the v0.34 stable line (8fed378, 2026-09-07) — not GitHub Latest (v0.34.0). Native Klein 4B + Wan 2.2 + LTX-2.5 loaders. Torch cu130. Frontend still 1.49.6. Rebuild the comfy image stage after this bump (torch stage stays cached). Spark free-memory patch still matches mem_free_cuda, _ = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(dev) in comfy/model_management.py. COMFYUI_MANAGER_REF 4.2.2 Latest stable Manager tag; requires-python >= 3.9; no hard ComfyUI version floor. COMFYUI_NUNCHAKU_NODE_REF v1.2.1 Latest plugin release; aligned with NUNCHAKU_VERSION=1.2.1. Optional on GB10 (no official aarch64 engine wheels). When the engine is missing, start moves the pack to ComfyUI-nunchaku.disabled so Comfy does not import it. *-lab-example graphs use core UNET/CLIP/VAE loaders. COMFYUI_VHS_REF (empty = main) ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite for lab VHS_VideoCombine MP4. Required for wan-*-lab-example / ltx-*-lab-example. Empty ref clones default branch; set a tag/branch when you need a pin. COMFYUI_OPENCUT_REF 0.5.0 jtydhr88/ComfyUI-OpenCut MIT embed. Fail-soft. Not the Rust rewrite. COMFYUI_MAGCACHE_REF 47bdd2a… Zehong-Ma/ComfyUI-MagCache commit pin (no release tag). Wan 5B draft extra only. ComfyUI v0.34 dropped module-level precompute_freqs_cis; docker/patch_magcache_compat.py wraps that import in every MagCache module that still has it (nodes.py and nodes_calibration.py) and fail-softs the calibration import in __init__.py. Idempotency is per file so a volume that already wrapped nodes.py still gets calibration on the next start. MagCache-on-LTX stays unsupported. COMFYUI_LTX_DIRECTOR_REF a3c809c… WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI GPL clone only when LAB_ENABLE_LTX_DIRECTOR=1. Commit pin (no release tag).

How to bump pins: change the defaults in docker/Dockerfile ARGs, docker/docker-compose.yml build-args, .github/workflows/publish-image.yml, docker/install-comfy/core.sh (torch) and docker/install-comfy/common.sh (Comfy/node refs), then rebuild/publish. Escape hatch: set COMFYUI_REF= empty to float the default branch (not recommended for GHCR).

What's on this page

  • Queue the rap draft first, then the full track
  • Forty-five 180 s Nill Bye vs Rake diss examples under _lab/audio/nill-bye/ (Queue on their own; lab catalog, style pack, trap/EDM pack; exclusive bars per take)
  • Thirty 180 s Drive-through rave-set EDM examples under _lab/audio/drive-through/ (Queue on their own; American festival EDM, drop early, dirty pyro on every drop; vocals are a rare DJ treat on two graphs)
  • App Mode: tags, lyrics, rewrite, vocal/instrumental, duration
  • Tags vs lyrics; [verse] / [chorus] / [spoken word] as vocal hints; EDM uses [inst] / [intro] / [outro], plus one short [chorus] chop on the two DJ-shout treats
  • Original lyrics only — no “in the style of \<living artist>”
  • ACE-Step vocal = invented identity, not a clone
  • DistroKid / Spotify / YouTube / USCO Part 2 disclosure
  • download-music --tier turbo; sequential Queue + existing Klein covers
  • Optional YouTube still-video: host audio-still-video after Queue (graphs stay FLAC + MP3)
  • Spark: ~10 GB AIO; do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein

What this enables

  • Reusing the podcast ACE-Step AIO dest so the 10 GB file is not pulled twice
  • Keeping the visual studio bootable when the music pack is missing
  • Muxing a cover still + FLAC into a YouTube MP4 without changing the rap graphs

Not legal advice

Platform rules and copyright change. Read the current DistroKid, Spotify, YouTube, FTC, and USCO pages before you monetize.

Cover still in a later Klein session. Do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein.

docs.title: Tags vs lyrics
docs.text:
• Tags describe genre, drums, bass, booth, vocal character, and bpm.
  • Lyrics are the bars (rap) or the arrangement score (Drive-through EDM). Section labels [intro], [verse], [chorus], [outro], and [spoken word] are vocal hints operators may add — they are not a rights grant. EDM graphs use [inst] for the bed, build, and drops. Twenty-eight takes stay instrumental. Two rave-set treats add one short [chorus] DJ chop (never [verse]).
  • Original lyrics only. Do not write “in the style of \<living artist>”. No living-MC names. No famous-hook paraphrases.
  • Short percussive lines (about 6–10 syllables) slur less. Keep language=en on TextEncodeAceStepAudio1.5 (combo, not free text). The seeded graph stores seed control as fixed after the seed; re-open music-rap-draft-lab-example after a pull so those combos stay aligned.

ACE-Step generates the vocal from lyrics + tags. That timbre is an invented identity, not a cloned MC. Do not add Kokoro / Chatterbox / TTS-Audio-Suite to these graphs.

docs.title: DistroKid, Spotify, YouTube, authorship
docs.text:
• DistroKid / Spotify: you must own the rights. Disclose AI lyrics + vocals + instrumental. If the artist identity is fake, Spotify may treat it as an “AI Persona” — prefer a human artist name with disclosed AI production.
  • YouTube: use the synthetic-audio / altered-content flag. Mass-upload of near-duplicates is inauthentic content.
  • USCO Part 2 / Thaler: edit the lyrics. Prompts are not authorship. A human rewrite plus selection and arrangement can be; raw generations are not registrable.

docs.text:

./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier xl        # optional XL split only

${MODELS_DIR}/comfy/checkpoints/ace_step_1.5_turbo_aio.safetensors   # relative symlink

docs.title: Sequential Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo
  2. ./scripts/manage.sh start — type yes
  3. Load music-rap-draft-lab-example. Enhance on. Queue. Files under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR} as ez_rap_draft_*.flac / ez_rap_draft_*.mp3
  4. Then load music-rap-full-lab-example (96 s), or one music-rap-nill-bye-*-lab-example (180 s) from _lab/audio/nill-bye/ on its own, or one music-edm-drive-through-*-lab-example (180 s rave-set take) from _lab/audio/drive-through/ on its own

docs.title: Hard no
docs.text:
Do not vendor or default:

  • TTS-Audio-Suite, OldTimeRadio, cloud ace-step/ACE-Step-ComfyUI
  • MiniMax Music 3 as a lab default, MiniMax H3, Suno / Udio, Stable Audio 2.5 partner

docs.title: Local podcast
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Option A (audio-first commercial episode) vs Option B (one-graph radio drama)
  • App Mode: script, bed/sting tags, length, Kokoro stock voices (refs stay graph-only)
  • Why TTS-Audio-Suite and OldTimeRadio are not vendored
  • Kokoro default on Spark; Chatterbox / Qwen3-TTS optional
  • Native ACE-Step instrumental beds
  • Voice consent, platform rules, and authorship
  • download-podcast usage, sequential Queue, and loudnorm
  • Optional YouTube still-video: host audio-still-video after cover (not Apple Podcasts)
  • Clone-and-translate of a recorded show is a different lane: Local dub

What this enables

  • Queue a local two-host episode without cloud TTS or rented music
  • Keep the visual studio bootable when podcast extras are missing
  • Disclose synthetic voices in the mix, not only in a description box
  • Mux a cover still + episode FLAC into a YouTube MP4 without changing the episode graph

Not legal advice

Platform rules and copyright change. Read the current Apple, YouTube, Spotify, FTC, and USCO pages before you monetize.

docs.title: Two operator paths
docs.text: Do not load Klein + Wan + LTX + ACE-Step + TTS in one session. Cover art is a separate graph.

docs.title: Option A — audio-first commercial episode
docs.text:
Graph: podcast-audio-first-lab-example (extra.lab_profile us-safe-podcast).

Stage What runs Prefix SCRIPT App Script + Rewrite script. In-tree EZPodcastScript (enhance off so Speaker A: / Speaker B: stay parser input). Missing GGUF passes the widget through ez_podcast_script DISCLOSURE EZPodcastDisclosure prepends the spoken bumper (string) VOICES App Speaker A / B, Include announcer, Speaking speed. EZKokoroTTS Kokoro-82M ONNX/CPU built-ins. Voice-clone refs stay graph-only ez_podcast_voice BEDS App Bed tags, Rewrite bed, Bed length (seconds). Native Comfy ACE-Step 1.5, instrumental (lyrics hidden) ez_podcast_bed MIX Duck −15 dB + overlay. FLAC master + 320 kbps MP3 ez_podcast_ep / ez_podcast_mix COVER Queue klein-podcast-cover-lab-example separately (1024², ez_podcast) ez_podcast

First spoken line is always:

Voices and music on this show are synthesized. The hosts are original characters, not recordings of real people.

Do not type that line yourself. The disclosure node prepends it.

docs.title: Option B — one-graph radio drama
docs.text:
Graph: podcast-radio-drama-lab-example (us-safe-radio). Same legal engines. Writer prompt is lab-original fiction (radio_drama.txt), not a news rewrite. App Mode: Script, Sting tags / Bed tags, sting and bed length, Speaker A / B / Announcer, Include announcer, Speaking speed. ACE-Step sting + bed stay instrumental (lyrics hidden). One master mix (ez_radio_ep / ez_radio_mix).

Optional Wan silent bumper / LTX 5s hook groups default off (node mode never). Queue wan-bumper-loop-lab-example or ltx-hook-av-lab-example in a later session. Not a one-graph film.

docs.title: Why those packs are not vendored
docs.text:
This lab does not git-clone, pip-require, or default to:

  • TTS-Audio-Suite — many engines, including F5-TTS CC-BY-NC, Fish NC, Higgs commercial traps, VibeVoice research-only, and ARM wheel pain on GB10
  • ComfyUI-OldTimeRadio — optional lanes that pull US-excluded or non-commercial video models
  • Cloud ACE-Step forks, MiniMax Music, F5-TTS official weights, Coqui XTTS v2, Echo-TTS, Fish Audio S2, celebrity reference WAVs, ElevenLabs, or xAI TTS

Native ACE-Step 1.5 already ships in COMFYUI_REF=v0.34.6 (TextEncodeAceStepAudio1.5, EmptyAceStep1.5LatentAudio). Beds stay instrumental (instrumental, no vocals in tags; empty lyrics). Rap vocals with original lyrics live on Local music and reuse this same AIO dest — do not download it twice.

docs.title: Engines on Spark
docs.text:
Engine License Role Default download? Kokoro-82M ONNX Apache 2.0 Default TTS, built-in voices, CPU/aarch64-safe No — download-podcast --tier analog ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO MIT Instrumental beds No — --tier acestep Chatterbox Turbo MIT Optional GPU TTS; PerTh watermark stays on No — --tier chatterbox Qwen3-TTS 0.6B Apache 2.0 Optional TTS + voice design No — --tier qwen3tts Qwen3-4B-Instruct GGUF Apache 2.0 Script draft, fail-soft Already in download-models

Empty Chatterbox/Qwen3 refs fall back to Kokoro built-ins. Never drop celebrity WAVs into the graph.

kokoro-onnx / onnxruntime are optional runtime installs inside the container venv. They are not baked in phase-nodes.sh (a new pip would invalidate venv-extra, not the multi‑GB torch layer). Analog graphs still load if the wheel is missing; Queue fail-softs until you install it and download-podcast --tier analog.

docs.title: Voice consent and invented characters
docs.text: Hosts are original characters, not recordings of real people. Operator-owned reference clips are allowed only when you have rights. Do not clone living people. Do not ship Rogan/Ramsay-style refs in this repo. Translating a recorded podcast while keeping the original speakers is Local dub (dub-localize-lab-example), with a rights attestation on every Queue.

docs.title: Platform and US rules (operator checklist)
docs.text:
• Apple Podcasts 1.11 — disclose material AI audio in the content and in metadata
  • YouTube — use the synthetic/altered content toggle; July 2026 inauthentic-content rules (no template slop, no AI doctor / lawyer / finance-advisor persona)
  • Spotify — allowed if you own the rights, disclose, and do not use unconsented clones
  • FTC — spoken sponsor reads; synthetic persona endorsements need both a paid-connection disclosure and “this voice is AI”
  • USCO Part 2 / Thaler — prompts are not authorship. A human-edited script plus selection, arrangement, and mix can be. Raw generations are not registrable
